title: Tracing Bias Propagation Across Subgroups in Federated Learning
description: We show that the impact of false-negative errors on recipient client–subgroup pairs can be predicted from the global model's curvature together with source and recipient-group feature summaries, without retraining a model for each possible error. Notably, a non-target subgroup can experience the largest degradation.

inputs.label: Mislabelled subgroup
inputs.description: Source subgroup at client 0 whose positives get flipped: A0-B1 … A0-B4, A1-B1 … A1-B4 (A = audit attribute, B = Z quartile band)

inputs.label: Flip fraction
inputs.description: Fraction ρ of that subgroup's positive labels changed 1 → 0 (paper: 0.1–0.4)

inputs.label: Client heterogeneity
inputs.description: h: shifts the mean of predictor R by h·(0, −1, 0, 1) across clients (paper: 0, 0.5, 1)

inputs.label: Clients
inputs.description: Number of clients (2–8); client 0 is the source

inputs.label: Coefficients

inputs.label: A→R association
